prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original fan-made production sprite sheet for a side-view tactical video game, faithful to Metal Gear Solid V The Phantom Pain (1984). EXACTLY 4 columns by 4 rows, exactly 16 independently DRAWN full-body poses of ONE same character. Pure flat magenta #FF00FF canvas with five thin continuous pure cyan #00FFFF vertical grid lines and five horizontal grid lines, including outer boundaries. Each equal square cell must contain exactly one complete character, wholly inside, generous empty margin at least 30 pixels, no extremity or equipment on guides. Fixed camera, strict orthographic RIGHT-facing profile, feet bottom aligned, identical physical scale every frame. Detailed crisp military pixel art, clear small-scale silhouette, no scenery, no ground shadow, no text, no labels, no logos, no watermark. The sixteen poses must be genuinely different drawings, never simple shifted duplicates. Four phases per row in left-to-right time order, preserve all costume and identity features in EVERY pose. Keep weapons and hands compact inside their cell. Subject: the Man on Fire / burned Volgin in MGSV The Phantom Pain, faithful to the Konami Play Arts Kai Man on Fire figure. Tall extremely broad muscular adult male soldier silhouette, short charred red-black hair, scorched craggy human face, fitted charcoal burned sneaking/combat suit with broad segmented chest armour, thick metallic forearm plates, red-orange belts encircling upper thighs, heavy boots. Subtle molten orange-red cracks across charcoal armour. Actual compact orange-yellow flame tongues attached to shoulders, forearms and calves, strong warm silhouette accents. NOT naked, not skeleton, not Ghost Rider, no skull head, no helmet, no guns, no floating fireball. Row1: four powerful idle phases, shoulders breathing, flame tongues naturally changing as authored drawings. Row2: four compact heavy rightward walking stages alternating knee and foot placement. Row3: four charge poses bringing fists toward chest then extending one palm forward, compact attached flames brighten. Row4: four melee attack phases winding right arm close to body, compact forward punch, followthrough, return guarded stance. Character always strict right-facing profile. Preserve enough dark solid body to remain legible on any game background. Flames ONLY attached and fully inside each cell with all body parts, no floor fire, no detached VFX or embers.

notes: Charred muscular soldier, red-orange thigh straps, forearm plates and attached readable fire retained.
Melee and charge drawings are archive animation interpretations, not a new implemented boss moveset.
